import itertools
from collections import Counter

def comps_of(g, col):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    cells = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == col}
    out = []
    while cells:
        c = cells.pop(); comp = [c]; st = [c]
        while st:
            r, cc = st.pop()
            for dr, dc in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                n = (r + dr, cc + dc)
                if n in cells:
                    cells.remove(n); comp.append(n); st.append(n)
        out.append(comp)
    return out

def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    cnt = Counter(x for row in g for x in row); bg = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others = [c for c in cnt if c != bg]
    bar = seed = None
    for c in others:
        if len(comps_of(g, c)) == 2:
            bar = c
        else:
            seed = c
    bars = comps_of(g, bar)
    dots = sorted((r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == seed)
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    for em, mir in itertools.permutations(bars):
        rs = [r for r, _ in em]; cs = [c for _, c in em]
        if max(cs) - min(cs) >= max(rs) - min(rs):  # horizontal bar -> vertical lines
            below = all(r > max(rs) for r, _ in dots); above = all(r < min(rs) for r, _ in dots)
            if not (below or above): continue
            off = [c - min(cs) for _, c in dots]
            if len(set(off)) != len(off): continue
            allr = [r for r, _ in em] + [r for r, _ in mir]
            lo, hi = min(allr), max(allr)
            mstart = min(c for _, c in mir)
            if not all(0 <= mstart + o < w for o in off): continue
            for (dr, dc), o in zip(dots, off):
                c = min(cs) + o
                rng = range(min(rs) + 1, dr + 1) if below else range(max(rs) - 1, dr - 1, -1)
                for r in rng: out[r][c] = 4 if (r, c) == (dr, dc) else seed
            for o in off:
                c = mstart + o
                for r in range(lo, hi + 1):
                    if out[r][c] == bg: out[r][c] = seed
            return out
        else:  # vertical bar -> horizontal lines
            right = all(c > max(cs) for _, c in dots); left = all(c < min(cs) for _, c in dots)
            if not (right or left): continue
            off = [r - min(rs) for r, _ in dots]
            if len(set(off)) != len(off): continue
            allc = [c for _, c in em] + [c for _, c in mir]
            lo, hi = min(allc), max(allc)
            mstart = min(r for r, _ in mir)
            if not all(0 <= mstart + o < h for o in off): continue
            for (dr, dc), o in zip(dots, off):
                r = min(rs) + o
                rng = range(min(cs) + 1, dc + 1) if right else range(max(cs) - 1, dc - 1, -1)
                for c in rng: out[r][c] = 4 if (r, c) == (dr, dc) else seed
            for o in off:
                r = mstart + o
                for c in range(lo, hi + 1):
                    if out[r][c] == bg: out[r][c] = seed
            return out
